32.desc: Flag at data +0x4D (getter 0x02C09090). Only vanilla use: Wii Fit Trainer d-tilt push box; label kept, not verified.

33.name: HitAllStates
33.desc: Widens the victim-state accept field (accept word bits 8-10) from 3 to 7, letting the hitbox hit a 3rd target class normal hitboxes skip. Only Jigglypuff's Puff Up FS uses it.

34.name: FacingRestrict
34.desc: Facing / side check (LR check). 3 most common, 0, 1, 4, 6, 5, 2. Shulk Back Slash: 3 front set, 6 back-hit set. Hitbox (24-param) takes the module default (AttackModule +0x11A).

35.name: NoGrabRelease
35.desc: A hit from the fighter currently holding the victim doesn't count as a release hit (the captured victim's damage check 0x02C233C0 skips hits whose attacker is its link parent and that have this set). Set on every pummel and throw; also on most ledge attacks and many b-airs, where it has no effect.

39.name: Flinchless
39.desc: Victim doesn't flinch (no damage reaction); hurt code 0x02C24DF4 takes a separate path when set.

43.name: HitstunMul
43.desc: Multiplies the hitstun this hit gives the opponent (the game's own: knockback x 0.4). 0 or less = x1 (normal).

44.name: HitstopMul
44.desc: Multiplies the opponent's hitstop (hitlag) from this hit, on top of the Hitlag parameter. 0 or less = x1.

45.name: HitstopFrames
45.desc: The opponent's hitstop in frames, replacing the computed one (HitstopMul is then ignored). 0 = computed.

46.name: SelfHitstopMul
46.desc: Multiplies the attacker's own hitstop from this hit. 0 or less = x1.

47.name: SelfHitstopFrames
47.desc: The attacker's own hitstop in frames, replacing the computed one. 0 = computed.

48.name: DIMul
48.desc: Multiplies how far DI can turn this hit's launch angle (0.5 = half, 2 = double). 0 or less = x1; for no DI use a tiny value (0.001).

29.name: Reflectable

30.name: Absorbable

32.name: IgnoreInvuln

33.name: HitAllStates
33.desc: Widens the victim-state accept field (accept word bits 8-10) from 3 to 7, letting the hitbox hit a 3rd target class normal hitboxes skip. Only Jigglypuff's Puff Up FS uses it.

34.name: FacingRestrict
34.desc: Facing / side check (LR check). 3 most common, 0, 1, 4, 6, 5, 2. Shulk Back Slash: 3 front set, 6 back-hit set. Hitbox (24-param) takes the module default (AttackModule +0x11A).

35.name: NoGrabRelease
35.desc: A hit from the fighter currently holding the victim doesn't count as a release hit (the captured victim's damage check 0x02C233C0 skips hits whose attacker is its link parent and that have this set). Set on every pummel and throw; also on most ledge attacks and many b-airs, where it has no effect.

39.name: Flinchless
39.desc: Victim doesn't flinch (no damage reaction); hurt code 0x02C24DF4 takes a separate path when set.

40.name: Shape
40.desc: Collision shape kind: 0 sphere, 2 capsule (X2/Y2/Z2; X2 = X if no end point is given). Extended_* commands force 2. Shapes are pooled per kind (0x02C108C4 / 0x02C118E4).

Set on every pummel and throw; also on most ledge attacks and many b-airs, where it has no effect.
